body.estimand_functional: \(\theta_j(P)=\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{b\in\{-1,+1\}}H_{j,b}(P)\) on the identified restricted-ANM domain. On the explicit sub-half Hermite chart, the proved observable relation \(\operatorname{sign}(\mathbb E_P\psi(X_j,Y_j))=\theta_j(P)\) yields \(N_{\mathrm H}^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\asymp\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) unconditionally. For the larger class, only \(N^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\gtrsim\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) is asserted.

sampling_model.design: An i.i.d. sample \(\mathcal W_n\sim P^{\otimes n}\) from a product of \(d\) labelled bivariate laws.
sampling_model.units: Each observation contains all \(d\) supplied independent cause--effect pairs.
sampling_model.treatment: There is no designated treatment; the causal target is the orientation vector \(\theta\).
sampling_model.overlap: Each true cause and structural noise has an everywhere-positive density within one fixed Gaussian-tail envelope.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The four-fold local-polynomial class \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\) is retained only for the negative result: its declared simultaneous \(L^4\) event fails on a fixed legal chart law because a tail neighborhood is empty with nonvanishing probability. The unconditional chart estimator uses no fitted regression or residual-HSIC statistic; it evaluates one explicit antisymmetric moment per supplied pair and applies deterministic median-of-means blocks.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: GENE combines neural-network explained variance with a discretized chi-square independence-test indicator in its order score; the present oracle fixed-HSIC score is only inspired by that architecture.
The directed acyclic graph becomes identifiable from the distribution under the restricted additive-noise conditions.
Regression plus independence testing is pointwise consistent under a suitable learner.
Estimated residuals require a nuisance-specific asymptotic analysis.
Observed-variable independence tests can be minimax-rate optimal against smooth local alternatives.
Permutation tests admit a general nonasymptotic minimax-power analysis.
Residual ordering and split-sample independence testing have pointwise asymptotic guarantees.
Residual-bootstrap ordering confidence sets are asymptotically valid.
Exact simultaneous recovery can exhibit a logarithmic dimension phase transition.
Observed-variable martingale HSIC has a normal calibration under independence and kernel moment conditions.

body.tldr: The headline has two honest parts. First, the explicit fixed local-polynomial nuisance protocol cannot satisfy its advertised simultaneous \(L^4\) event even for one legal positive-density Hermite-chart law, so the former conditional full-class upper and confidence theorems were vacuous. Second, after restricting to an explicit sub-half Hermite chart, the observable antisymmetric moment \(\psi(X,Y)=(X^2-1)Y-(Y^2-1)X\) has mean \(\theta\,2t(1-2a)\), bounded variance, and squared signal of order the wrong-direction residual-HSIC margin \(\lambda\). A median-of-means rule and product mirrors therefore give the unconditional matched frontier \(N_{\mathrm H}^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\asymp\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) and a computable simultaneous confidence set on that chart. The orientation-permuted attainable rectangle and the full-class product lower bound remain unconditional. The navigation score is GENE-inspired, not literally the published GENE score.

project_justification.gap: Published restricted-ANM results identify direction and regression--HSIC procedures have pointwise consistency, but neither supplies a uniform exact-recovery frontier for many supplied independent pairs. The attempted fixed local-polynomial route also concealed a genuine tail-design obstruction: its simultaneous \(L^4\) regression event fails inside the declared positive-density envelope.
project_justification.niche: The note separates feasible population geometry from statistical feasibility. Its explicit Hermite subchart is small enough to admit a computable nuisance-free orientation moment, yet rich enough to contain legal coordinate-swapped alternatives with residual-HSIC signal and testing information both of order \(\lambda\).
project_justification.fill: The feasible-image theorem supplies the local GENE-inspired-gain--HSIC rectangle. The new negative theorem closes the fixed local-polynomial kill test. On a calibrated interval \(0<a_-<a_+<1/2\), the antisymmetric moment gives a median-of-means estimator with simultaneous exponential error, while the same chart mirrors give the matching all-procedure lower bound and singleton obstruction. This proves the unconditional chart frontier without claiming a full-class upper bound. Wornbard et al. are credited for the non-archival presolve insight, not used as a theorem source.

body.related_work: Li et al. (2025, Equation (6) and Theorem 4.3) motivate the navigation architecture, but their published GENE score uses neural-network \(R^2\) and a discretized chi-square independence-test indicator. The score here instead uses population explained variance and the oracle indicator \(\mathbf 1\{H>0\}\) for fixed characteristic Gaussian-kernel HSIC, so it is described only as GENE-inspired. Peters et al. (2014, Definition 27 and Theorem 28) provide the restricted positive-density identification domain; for a disjoint-edge DAG their multivariate condition reduces to the imposed pairwise Condition 19. Mooij et al. (2016, Appendix A) prove pointwise consistency of regression plus fixed-kernel HSIC under a suitable learner, not the uniform many-pair frontier here. Hl\'avka, Hu\v{s}kov\'a, and Meintanis (2011) emphasize that estimated residuals need a nuisance expansion; the present negative theorem shows that the particular fixed local-polynomial \(L^4\) event proposed here is impossible, without converting that failure into an HSIC-error rate. Shekhar, Kim, and Ramdas (2023), Kim, Balakrishnan, and Wasserman (2022), and Pfister et al. (2018) concern observed-variable or pointwise independence testing. Wang, Kolar, and Drton (2026) provide asymptotically valid ordering sets, while Gao and Stoev (2020) motivate exact simultaneous recovery transitions. Acharya et al. (2023) study a discrete interventional experiment and Jin (2026) studies linear LiNGAM primitive margins; neither is the nonlinear observational product experiment here. Wornbard et al. receive non-archival credit for the presolve geometry insight; no public theorem under that attribution is used.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The matched upper bound is proved only on \(\mathcal M_d^{\mathrm H}(\lambda)\), the explicit sub-half Hermite-chart subclass. The local-polynomial theorem establishes failure of one prescribed uniform \(L^4\) nuisance event; it does not prove that residual HSIC is intrinsically hard to estimate, does not yield a nuisance-limited minimax bracket, and does not exclude a different full-class estimator. Consequently the full separated restricted-ANM class currently has the product lower bound but no matching upper bound.
body.honest_scope: Unconditional results are the attainable GENE-inspired-gain--HSIC rectangle, the fixed-protocol local-polynomial impossibility theorem, the product-testing lower bound, and the matched median-of-means frontier and confidence set on the explicit sub-half Hermite chart. The chart is a strict subclass of the note's independent-pair, unit-variance, weighted-Hölder, Gaussian-envelope, margin-window model, itself a strict subclass of Peters et al.'s corresponding restricted-ANM domain. A converse transfers upward through these inclusions; the chart achievability does not. No full-class upper frontier or generated-residual HSIC expansion is claimed.
body.interpretation: On the calibrated Hermite chart, residual HSIC remains the identifying population functional, while the antisymmetric moment is merely an observed-law estimating device whose sign is proved to equal the causal orientation. The GENE-inspired gain is used to define the feasible navigation window; it is not estimated by the chart rule and is not represented as the published GENE algorithm.
